'''Sordaan's Rodian Hunter Outpost''', also called '''Sordaan's Space Station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] established by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Sordaan Xris]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Xris purchased a writ of protection from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] in exchange for this area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Freelance Rodian [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were hired to protect the base and Xris' business partners during the Rodians' hunting operations on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The base's security was overseen by [[Rodian Base Security Chief|Xris' security chief]].
